environment: Linux; existing s2n-arm-mlkem shelf with one effective proof seat; no shelf rebuilt
evidence_boundary: Complete 256-cell ARM NTT layers 1-3 functional source under its original premises, after checked project dependency preparation. This does not claim all NTT layers or an independent alignment, ABI, instruction-semantics or publication audit.
runtime_identity_note: Execution commits were frozen before delivery attempts. Later verification HEADs may add documentation only; non-documentation Git trees and runtime backend hashes must still match. Receipt client revision remains unknown and non-authoritative. Earlier receipts are never reassigned to a newer documentation commit.
external_source_distribution: External proof sources, ELF bytes, raw transcripts, original receipts, machine configuration and memory images remain outside the public repository.

source_identity.preservation: Exact source and object hashes match the prior recorded functional case; no theorem premise or frame is weakened.

timing_scope: admission_wait_seconds is the receipt-reported admission wait, not total waiting time. It can omit earlier project-basis lock admission waiting, so evaluation plus this field does not establish end-to-end wall time. A queued attempt has no recorded evaluation result until its receipt completes. Evaluation measurements overlap other work and are not a controlled runtime speed comparison.
target_evidence_boundary: All six original preparation/leaf targets use literal source quotations. Accepted probes check kernel conclusions and empty hypotheses. Quotation hashes preserve layout-sensitive source provenance, not semantic theorem equivalence. Proof activity is diagnostic only.
foundation_boundary: Observed registry deltas are relative to the restored warm or retained project basis; zero observed new axioms does not inventory pre-existing basis axioms.
